scope: Freeze known original DDAC Dragon buy and immediate full-token transfer-to-manager sale candidate. Query BNB native EOA historical balance in four exact states (buy_block-1,buy_block,sale_block-1,sale_block); original tx, external EOA tx count in each touched block with excludeZeroValue=false, and receipt header gasUsed/effectiveGasPrice when possible. Balance delta includes gas and unrelated txs; only infer original BNB receipt when exactly one sender tx in block and no other inbound native transfers and full gas cost verified. Otherwise actual PnL unknown.
